copied_from.why: PLAN.md §1: values are copied, not linked. A duplicated table is cheaper than a coupling to harness-core, which is untouched evidence for the experiments. The cost of copying is drift, and this block is the only defence — it names the upstream revision these rates came from so a mismatch is discoverable.
copied_from.drift_check: diff these rates against harness-core/config/routing.json's model_prices_usd_per_mtok. A difference means one of the two is stale; neither file's version stamp alone can tell you which.

columns.cache_write: cache write at the 5-minute TTL, 1.25x input — the only write column an Alfred run can incur, because the gateway pins the TTL at 5m
columns.cache_write_1h: cache write at the 1-hour TTL, 2x input. Recorded for completeness and NOT charged: a 1h breakpoint is rejected by the gateway, so a figure using this column would be billing for something that cannot happen.

billing_assumption: First-party Claude API, standard (non-batch) list rates, inference_geo global (no 1.1x data-residency multiplier), fast mode off. Batch (-50%), fast mode (Opus $10/$50), and US-only residency (1.1x) stack on top and are NOT reflected here.

unpriced_by_design.long_context: Ids carrying a [1m] marker (observed: claude-opus-4-8[1m], anthropic.claude-opus-4-6-v1[1m]) are the 1M-context variants. Their rates are above the standard row past 200k and are not published here, so they are reported as unpriced rather than charged at the standard rate. A premium call billed at the standard rate is a plausible figure that is quietly too low, which is worse than a hole.

claude-sonnet-5.why_here_and_not_in_the_row: Every row has the same five columns, so a lookup cannot be correct on one row's shape and wrong on another's. The rates below are the introductory ones.

free_by_design.<synthetic>: Not a billable model. It is the recorded model value for assistant entries that carry no model id, and it exists so those entries stop forcing cost.complete:false. It is the one id for which $0 is the honest figure, so it must not be reported as unpriced.
